ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The diagram is a food web, with the label “Toad” in the left-middle position. From “Toad” there is an arrow pointing upward to “Hognose Snake”. Then reason: Arrows in a food web usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Because the arrow points from Toad to Hognose Snake, the one that eats the toad is hognose snake.
